whenToUse: Comments or messages in collaboration tools.
A specific person must be notified.
Spaces with a set group of participants.
whenNotToUse: Places where letting anyone call anyone would be a problem, such as public boards.
So many people that names collide.

alternatives.name: Combobox
alternatives.reason: Choosing a value from a list while typing.

accessibility: The input is a combobox and the list a listbox.
Arrow keys move, Enter or Tab inserts, and Esc closes.
The current option is announced with aria-activedescendant.
When no one matches, it says so in words.
